The verse material of the sutta possesses widespread parallels across early Buddhist literature and the broader Indian textual tradition. In the Pali Canon, passage-level parallels are found in the *Dhammapada* (Dhp 131–132, in the *Daṇḍavagga*); corresponding verses are attested in the Patna Dharmapada (P-Dhp 195–215), the Sanskrit *Udānavarga* (UV 30, *Sukhavarga*), the Tibetan translation (*Uv Kg* 30), and multiple Chinese translations, including T 210 (chapter 18), T 212 (chapter 31), and T 213 (chapter 30). Outside Buddhist literature, related verses occur in the *Mahābhārata* (13.114.005) and the *Manusmṛti* (5.45).
